entities.name: Michael Schumacher
entities.description: Schumacher exercised four hours a day, mostly to strengthen his neck muscles to better withstand G-forces during races. In 2003, Deutsche Welle highlighted Schumacher's 'natural talent' for racing and his 'discipline and leadership'. In 2023, Fisichella observed that Schumacher 'did not even seem to have sweated' during races, adding that Schumacher is the greatest Formula One.
